title: PEMO resident-portal (Amenities & Booking) denylist
purpose: Field names that must never cross the resident booking boundary. Same scan idiom as the two existing lists: forbiddenPropertyNames match PROPERTY NAMES only, case-insensitively after stripping non-alphanumerics.

derivedByDiff.base: resident-mobile/forbidden-terms.json — booking is a resident-facing surface, so the resident boundary is the base, not the management one.
derivedByDiff.method: Every group of the resident-mobile list was kept, dropped, or modified for the booking domain, and booking-specific groups were added. Each decision is recorded here and in the Step 2 report. A denylist that cries wolf gets bypassed (resident-mobile's own 'unit' exception), so groups with no booking analogue are dropped rather than carried as noise.
kept: deviceIdentity — a facility's equipment must never leak an asset/device/equipment id to a resident.
carParkOperations — the car park is never bookable (R6, ADR-003); these terms flag car-park operational data leaking into a booking response.

dropped.telemetry: No sensor readings exist in a booking response.
dropped.clientConnectivity: Booking availability is a server-side SlotState, not device connectivity; these terms have no booking analogue.

modified.internalAndPrivacy: Kept the other-party/staff-internal terms; REMOVED the rate terms {price, cost, tariff} and the maintenance terms {workorder, workordercost, parts, partscost, invoice, procurement, inventory}. Booking rate cards and admin fees are resident-facing by design — this is the boundary INVERTING for booking, the way sourcedeviceref inverts for management. The removed rate terms are recorded as allowedExceptions; the maintenance terms have no booking analogue.

deviceIdentity.reason: Device/equipment/asset identity is never a resident's. Kept verbatim from resident-mobile.

carParkOperations.reason: The car park is never bookable (R6). A car-park operational field in a booking response is a leak, not a feature.

otherPartyAndInternal.reason: From resident-mobile's internalAndPrivacy, minus the rate and maintenance terms. A booking must never reveal another resident, a neighbour, or a staff-internal note.

bookingParty.reason: ADDED. Who holds or booked a slot must never be revealed — this is why SlotState collapses 'booked by another' and 'held' into `unavailable`. The holder's identity is another party's, forbidden exactly as otherresident is.

hkstpResidue.reason: ADDED. R4 deletes PUBLIC_USER/PARK_USER; the export's HKSTP sample data carried company/cost-centre/persona residue that must not survive into a residential product (R4, section 3.2).

allowedExceptions.why: Rate-card prices and from-price are resident-facing by design. The boundary inverts for booking: prices are shown, not hidden. Removed from the inherited internalAndPrivacy group for this reason.
Same as price — a facility's admin fee/cost is shown to the resident who will pay it.
Same. A rate tariff is resident-facing booking information.
adminFee is a modelled, resident-facing policy field (FacilityRules.adminFee).
A facility's capacity is resident-facing (FacilityCard.capacity, overview.capacity).
Inherited: resident-facing references are shown by design.
Inherited: resident-readable location is in scope; panel/zone/device identifiers are not (see deviceIdentity).
Inherited: PEMO's own entity name and the ordinary word for a home.

Membership STANDING (membership-required eligibility) is the caller's own — but membername/memberid are forbidden (bookingParty), because those name a party. Only the abstract 'membership' concept is in scope.
